title: Models + Endpoints
description: Configure and manage LLM models and their backend endpoint providers
azure_base_model_help: The actual model your azure deployment uses. Used for accurate cost tracking.
manage_fallback_chains_desc: Manage multiple fallback chains for different models (up to 5 groups at a time)
add_models_from_dropdown: Add models from the dropdown above
model_management_desc: Add and manage models for the proxy
model_management_desc_user: Add models for teams you are an admin for.
empty_models_desc: No models match your search or filters. Try resetting them.
only_db_models_editable: Only DB models can be edited. You must be an admin or the creator of the model to edit it.
reusable_credentials_desc: Credentials saved in LiteLLM that can be added to models repeatedly.
manual_credentials_desc: Credentials added directly during model creation or defined in the config file.
pause_tooltip_config: Config models cannot be paused from the dashboard. Pause is DB-backed.
pause_tooltip_admin_only: Only proxy admins can pause or resume a model.
pause_tooltip_pause: Pause model — stop routing requests until resumed.
delete_tooltip_config: Config model cannot be deleted on the dashboard. Please delete it from the config file.
delete_auto_router_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to delete this auto-router? This action cannot be undone.
delete_model_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to delete this model? This action cannot be undone.

tags.title: Tag Management
tags.description: Click on a tag name to view and edit its details. You can use tags to restrict the usage of certain LLMs based on tags passed in the request.
tags.no_tags_desc: Create a tag to start routing and restricting model usage.
tags.delete_tag_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this tag? This action cannot be undone.
tags.tpm_rpm_unsupported: TPM/RPM limits for tags are not currently supported.

auto_routers.title: Auto routers
auto_routers.desc: Auto routers sit above your deployments and pick a model per request. They are called like any other model, so clients keep using a single model name.
auto_routers.modal_desc: Routes each request to a model by classifying its complexity. Called like any other model, so clients keep using a single model name.
auto_routers.delete_msg: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Any client still calling this model name will start failing.
auto_routers.empty_desc_can_modify: Create an auto router to pick the right model per request instead of pinning one.
auto_routers.empty_desc_readonly: An auto router picks the right model per request instead of pinning one.
